question: Which of the following words were added in the Preamble by the Forty-second Amendment Act?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Socialist, secular**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Forty-second Amendment Act, 1976, added the words **"Socialist"** and **"Secular"** to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
 
• This amendment is known as the **Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976**.
